purpose: Bind the generated facade sill-drainage assembly and its physical tray edge-break refinement to one formal reflection-probe epoch across request, polling, completion and pre-still review, including Unity script/assembly reload boundaries. A genuinely missing fallback sill pass and deterministic tray/proxy refinement may be prepared before the first baseline; after arming, SessionState persists both the scene/root identity and an independent tray/proxy mesh fingerprint. All later checks are read-only and fail closed on replacement/deletion, mesh/proxy drift, authored/fallback changes, legacy-sill re-enablement, or structural/material/LOD/topology drift. This contract awards no Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: The 2 mm front edge break is a conservative benchmark reconstruction assumption, not a dimension attributed to an identified historic sash product.
This binding proves reflection-epoch coherence only; it does not prove that the reconstructed sill dimensions or edge-break scale are visually correct at benchmark distance.
Read-only post-arm validation cannot prove that drain openings read as physical recesses rather than overly dark holes in final pixels.
A stable mesh fingerprint cannot prove that anodized-aluminum Fresnel response, edge highlight width or contact shadowing are filmic under the actual midsummer lighting state.

SessionState intentionally persists until the Unity Editor process exits; a new formal epoch after source/scene edits should start from a clean Editor session rather than weakening the armed epoch in place.
A newly generated but unsaved root may not have a stable GlobalObjectId and must fail closed until the benchmark scene is persisted.
The binding cannot clear visible_lod_pop, highlight-centroid snap or severe_aliasing_or_shimmer; native-4K temporal evidence remains mandatory.
Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime behavior remains unverified until a real Runner executes mesh refinement, reflection request/poll/completion, an assembly reload boundary and pre-still validation.
